title: pfSense - Telegraf
description: pfSense edge operations: WireGuard handshakes, dpinger gateways, PF states, interfaces and system capacity.

options.content:
## pfSense Network Operations
**Edge health · WireGuard · Firewall · Capacity**    |   Read left to right for current conditions, then use the sections below to compare trends.

panels.title: Telegraf
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health.

panels.title: WG interface
panels.description: The interface's administrative UP flag. This does not prove end-to-end connectivity.

panels.title: Recent peers
panels.description: Peers that handshook less than 3 minutes before the latest successful collection. Idle clients are normal.

panels.title: WG peers
panels.description: Peers currently loaded into the tunnel interface.

panels.title: WG sample age
panels.description: The collector runs every 2 minutes. Peer state and interface status hide readings older than 6 minutes.

panels.title: Tunnel throughput
panels.description: Rolling 5-minute rates from the tun_wg0 interface counters.

panels.title: Received in range
panels.description: Estimated transfer over the selected dashboard time range.

panels.title: Sent in range
panels.description: Estimated transfer over the selected dashboard time range.

panels.title: Packets per second
panels.description: Including payload packets on the tunnel interface.

panels.title: Tunnel drops and errors
panels.description: Kernel interface counters. A flat zero is healthy.

panels.title: Peer activity history
panels.description: A peer can be idle without being disconnected. Counts are samples, not session durations.

panels.title: Per-peer traffic · 10m rate
panels.description: Stable peer IDs are hashes of public keys. No keys or endpoints appear in Prometheus.

panels.title: Peer handshake timeline
panels.description: Recent is under 3 minutes; idle is a past handshake, not a failure; never means none since the peer was loaded.

panels.title: Handshake age · seen peers
panels.description: Age of the most recent handshake. Never-seen peers are intentionally omitted.

panels.title: Round-trip latency and variation
panels.description: pfSense dpinger reports these values for its configured monitoring target.

panels.title: Probe packet loss
panels.description: Loss to the configured gateway monitoring target. This is not loss across every WAN destination.

panels.title: Gateway state history
panels.description: Only gateways reported by the status API appear here. Unmonitored gateways have no dpinger readings.

panels.title: PF state table vs hard limit
panels.description: Current connection states and the firewall's configured capacity.

panels.title: State creation and expiry
panels.description: Rates of PF state-table churn; comparable on the same scale.

panels.title: PF pressure and validation counters
panels.description: Diagnostic counters. They are not a count of all blocked packets.

panels.title: PF state lookups
panels.description: PF lookup workload and the PF match counter. No rate ratio is implied.

panels.title: Inbound by interface
panels.description: Use Interface to focus on a link or VLAN. Parent and VLAN counters can overlap; do not add them.

panels.title: Outbound by interface
panels.description: Interface rates are shown separately to avoid counting VLAN traffic twice.

panels.title: RX packet rate
panels.description: Packet workload by selected interface.

panels.title: TX packet rate
panels.description: Packet workload by selected interface.

panels.title: Interface drops and errors
panels.description: Select an interface to inspect its four counters without unrelated series.

panels.title: CPU modes
panels.description: Firewall CPU modes.

panels.title: Busy per core
panels.description: Shows imbalance that the total CPU figure can hide.

panels.title: Memory headroom
panels.description: FreeBSD memory categories. Do not add them as a total.

panels.title: Load averages
panels.description: Compare the short-term load with sustained 5m and 15m load.

panels.title: Free space by dataset
panels.description: Selected ZFS datasets. Their free space can share a pool and should not be summed.

panels.title: Process counts
panels.description: FreeBSD process states can help explain load with little CPU demand.
